en: Bats are not blind because they have good vision and only use echolocation to navigate in total darkness.
Plants do not get energy from soil since they make their own food through photosynthesis using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.
Goldfish do not have a three-second memory because they can actually remember things and learn tricks for several months.
The human tongue lacks specific taste zones since all taste buds can detect sweet, sour, salty, bitter, and umami flavors everywhere.
Human blood is never blue because it is always red, appearing dark red inside veins and bright red in oxygen.
Camels do not store water in their humps since they actually store fat there to use as energy when food is scarce.
Ostriches do not bury their heads in the sand because they simply lower their heads to the ground to hide from predators.
Daddy longlegs are not venomous spiders because they are actually harvestmen that lack venom glands and fangs entirely.
Sharks are not mindless man-eaters because they are highly intelligent predators that play a crucial role in keeping ocean ecosystems healthy.
Insects do not have lungs because they breathe through a network of tiny tubes called tracheae that deliver oxygen directly to tissues.
You cannot catch warts from touching toads because human warts are caused by a virus rather than the bumps on toad skin.
Mushrooms are not plants because they belong to the fungi kingdom and get their energy by absorbing nutrients from decaying matter.
